derivation:
by
  ext s hs
  simpa [Measure.map_apply (measurable_const_mul _) hs, ← Set.preimage_smul, smul_eq_mul, modulus_coe_units, (distribHaarChar_pos (A := F) (g := u)).ne'] using (distribHaarChar_mul ν u⁻¹ s).symm
explanation: Specialize the Haar scaling identity to the units acting on F and to u⁻¹. Measure extensionality and the preimage formula turn it into the stated pushforward identity; modulus on units is the distributive Haar character.
